title: "Decrease Text Size" wraps around.
description:
Decrease your text size too far, using "Control+-", and it wraps back to a
normalish size. "Regrowing" the text shrinks it down, then back up again.

-- 
Mike Hoye

title: Some sidebar bookmarks have the wrong icon (Oct 17 nightly build)
description:
The icons on the right of the bookmark in the sidebar sometime switch to the
icon of a different bookmark in the list when you select it.

Screenshot here: http://www.cfxweb.net/~delphigl/images/bookmarks.jpg

Would be nice to have a preference that disables per bookmark icons.
